gamerule.fillZombieCapOverSeconds.descri: The mod tries to spawn the target amount of zombies (difficulty dependent) over this many seconds assuming 1% of positions are spawnable
gamerule.maxNumberOfZombiesAdjustedByDif: Maximum (* difficulty) numbers of zombies to spawn
This number * globalDifficulty (easy -> 1.0,normal -> 2.0,hard -> 3.0) is the maximum amount of zombies to spawned around a player
gamerule.startingNumberOfZombies: Minimum number of zombies to spawn
gamerule.startingNumberOfZombies.descrip: Zombies mod tries to spawn at least this many zombies (around a player)
